query: What do Samsung Galaxy A51 reviews say about screen clarity, brightness, and touchscreen reliability?
search_text: What do reviews say about screen clarity, brightness, and touchscreen reliability?

rows.text: Nice size screen. Video recording screen and clarity is fantastic. Used it at my niece wedding and the playback is amazing.

Face recognition is almost flawless. And I have a very strange experience. before my screen protector came (and a lot of reviews on Youtube say this) the fingerprint sensor only works about 6 out of 10 times. but after I put the protector on it did not work at all. BUT I wiped the fingerprints and set them up again and now it works more like 8 out of 10 times. I have no idea why the protector would make it work better, but it does. Mine is the 4GB RAM. I was not expecting the 6GB version. I'm very happy with this phone and it probably made me become a Samsung customer for the future with midrange phones.

Great phone. The screen quality and the battery life rock!. I bought this phone for my mom. This is a great phone. Love the brightness and sharpness of the screen. Some people say this phone is slow but not too bad compare to my iPhone X. If I have to replace my phone for the similar price level, definitely this phone!

Very thin and slippery, however, and I'd read many reviews of breakage so I also ordered protective casing and screen protectors. I have never used fingerprint login on any of my other phones before and I've read that the tempered glass screen protectors make that feature difficult to use - I can't speak to that. Never used it before, don't miss it now. I'm 62. I'm not a gamer, so I don't need the highest/fastest processor. I need clear, bright, sharp visuals, a decent speaker, and enough speed so that I can play podcasts without stuttering. Reliable WiFi and Internet access are a must. This phone fits all of those criteria.

Best bang for buck!!. This device is absolutely amazing it handles high FPS games almost flawlessly however the optical fingerprint sensor does not work so well with a plastic screen protector not is the facial recognition reliable with a plastic screen protector other than that it's a flawless device!
Love this phone. Just know that the fingerprint reader requires precise application of your finger and the screen isn't as easy to see on a bright day. Those flaws aside I love the phone

affordable mid-price phone. 128GB was a must and not disappointed. It runs really quickly and does a lot of the thinking for you. clear bright screen, a bit bigger than I'd like, but this phone will last for years.

Apps work to perfection. Pictures are amazing.. I Love this phone though I do not like the fingerprint reader. It has many features and a ton of storage.The speaker volume and clarity is the best I've ever experienced in a cell phone! Screen clarity is divine!

Good value. Not the top of the line Galaxy but a very good value. I purchased to replace an older Motorola phone. Great screen, cameras, battery life, and will get droid updates for years. It would be nice if it was faster, but for anyone not playing intense games, it’s enough power for most activities. I have not tried the biometric features, but have not heard great reviews on them.

The case came with a screen protector that I really like. It has a flat screen so for the most part the case and protector work very well. I have noticed that the fingerprint recognition fails (a lot) when the screen is "asleep." If you activate the phone (press the side button) to activated the screen it works much, much better. Fingerprint reader works at about 90% accuracy if the screen is awake, with or without the screen protector. So... if wireless charging isn't a must, and you don't need higher than 1080P screen I would recommend this phone. I hate Apple so I can't compare it to their products The cameras are stupid good (front and back) I do not utilize the highest definition it is capable of. I like Samsung products so I am biased...

Relatively Inexpensive, Great Quality. I'm writing this review on the phone about 2 years after purchasing it. I DID break it once to the point of unusability. However, $170 screen replacement (internals and the glass) and it's in great shape. Only thing that has come up since is the vibration motor went out. I recommend the phone unless you want to go caseless or hold onto it for 5+ years.

Bad experience. The phone has a ghost marks on screen and keeps restarting every day.. The product is working properly, exterior not scratched and works properly. It has ghost marks on screen of a radio player stays on screen all the time. I wish I knew that before.

the screen was not working in bad condition. This phone was an Amazon renewed phone am sure the newer ones are great but this one isn’t the screen was not working properly the light was turned all the way up disability was poor the battery was ok .

I typed that workout fixing the errors to show you how bad it is. The touch screen is flawed. the mic barely works. do not buy this phone. there's a reason why it keeps going on sale. (edit). I'm back on the Moto G5. See any typos? No, none. KB and voice input is flawless, touchscreen is spot on. Don't buy a Samsung A51 based on the specs. The ts is so bad that when I touch the M key it registers backspace and I have to hold the bottom of the phone right up to my mouth for it to transcribe. The G5 isn't a great phone, it just works properly. The A51 is impossible to use while driving which is where I spend most of my time. I got rid of it. That being my first ever Samsung, my impression of their products has been deeply affected.
Good phone, bad screen. Phone itself great but warning. Screen scratches at like everything. get a protector

The best bang for the buck.... For an unlocked version. I upgraded this from a S8+ that I had for a few years. I got sick and tired of a lot of stuff that was on my old phone that I decided to upgrade. For $300 dollars, I wasn't expecting the clarity of the screen was between my S8+ and this phone. The picture was a whole lot better and it was crisper. It "flowed" more fluently between one window to the next. and I'm not having any issues with it thus far... (knock on wood). I think my only gripe with this phone is sometimes this phone will be the finger print reader... It's decent, but the delay of it is pretty long depending on how many apps are in the background. Overall, this exceeded what I was expecting between my S8+ and this.

Disappointed With The AMOLED Screen. I've had an AMOLED screen before and the colors were vivid and had great saturation, just a great screen. This one was medicore - like any TFT. I was also disappointed in the Samsung transfer app - Smartswitch. I was upgrading from an older Samsung. I've used this app before. It's fast and most things went. It did not move my assigned notificationn sounds for various text contacts and voice calls. I have a lot of them and did not want to reassign them. Re cameras, I'm not a discerning camera user. The camera specs are really good but I mostly take snap shots. I decided to return it, mostly due to the lackluster screen...

I've got to get with the 'make life simpler' game. Fingerprint: video recording test of the finger recognition passed with flying colors. **Here's where a problem lies- not the phone (at least not with mine) but with Screen Protectors. Many have hardly-visible dots in their design and these distort your finger print. I love the particular case I purchased but it comes with one of those protectors. I plan to order a different protector and cut this one out. From many screen protector reviews, though, it looks like this is a pretty common problem. Phone case: When finding a case, reading several reviews, I discovered that you have to be careful to not just find a A51 case, but specifically A51 4g. There are apparently other versions or something. So just keep your eye out. Personal opinion: This is an upgrade for me.

A great buy. I shopped a long time before deciding which phone to purchase. Battery life, specific capabilities and reliability were important to me. I have been very pleased with the ease of setting up the phone and maintaining the functions I actually needed. I recommend this model if you want to monitor specific activities, use text messaging and email, take photos and videos and have quality reception. The large screen is a plus! Thanks Samsung!

frustratingly slow device married to excellent screen. I downgraded to this phone from a Galaxy S10 after that phone died a premature death for no reason just after the warranty expired. I decided not to buy another premium level device because spending several hundred dollars for something that lasts just over a year doesn't make sense to me. Despite my disappointment in the early death of my previous Samsung device, I like that Samsung was still including microSD slots at the time they made this phone so that helped sway me to choose this phone versus a moderately priced Google Pixel device. How I wish I had read more reviews before buying this phone. The screen looks very nice. The fingerprint reader is a little finicky, but it generally works well. And the battery life is very good unless you are doing something that keeps the screen active constantly, like playing a game a watching videos.
